description: This is a service class (`BookService`) for managing Book entities within a Spring-based library/book management application. It provides methods for CRUD operations, JSON serialization of books, and various find/update functionalities specific to books and their relationships, including authors, shelves, and genres.

classes.name: BookService
classes.description: Spring service class for managing Book entities, including CRUD operations, search, update, and serialization functionalities.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieve a Book by its ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Save a Book entity after validating presence of author and shelf, and associate the book with author and publisher.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all books, defaulting to page 0 with 50 items.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieve books matching a text filter on title; otherwise, all books.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a given Book and possibly remove the associated author if they have no other books.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Delete all books and authors in the repository.

methods.name: getJsonRepresentationForBooksAsString
methods.description: Serialize list of all books into a formatted JSON string with root 'AllBooks'.

methods.name: findByShelfAndTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Placeholder for finding books by shelf, title, or author; throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Placeholder for finding books by title or author; throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Retrieve all books associated with a specific predefined shelf name.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Update an existing Book entity with data from BookPatchDto, including metadata, author, genres, and shelf.
